name: Broadhead arrow
description: A wide, wicked head that opens wounds rather than doors. Fletchers charge extra for the sharpening.
notes: A special arrow (the broadhead arrow profile, mw-e05.1). Special arrow band 3-8 per arrow (economy doc). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
